description: This file defines configuration-related classes for a plugin system within the WPEFramework project. It includes the 'Config' class for plugin configuration parameters, the 'Setting' class for logging settings, and references external modules and interfaces.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents the configuration parameters for a plugin, including identifiers, paths, startup options, and system settings.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A utility class for logging configuration settings with different data types.
